# Municipal Ordinance No. 7, Series of 2001

**Creating the Position of Social Welfare Aide in the MSWDO**

## Summary

This municipal ordinance establishes the position of Social Welfare Aide within the [[Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office]] (MSWDO) of [[Pitogo, Quezon]]. The ordinance outlines the aide's functions, duties, and responsibilities, and allocates funding for the position in the annual budget. It was enacted by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of [[Pitogo, Quezon]] on November 5, [[2001]].

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** Creates the position of Social Welfare Aide in the [[Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office]] with salary grade 4 in the plantilla of personnel schedule.
2.  **Section 2.** Defines the functions, duties, and responsibilities of the Social Welfare Aide, including:
    1) Assisting in organizing social groups to promote participation in activities involving information dissemination in food nutrition, home management, proper care of children, home industry and other development activities.
    2) Interview clients to determine eligibility for assistance. Make home visits and other referral visits to identify factors affecting social adjustment of clients.
    3) Record and evaluate information gathered to determine appropriate assistance to clients. Assist in the conduct of training courses or seminars and other information drives.
    4) Prepare periodic reports.
    5) Perform other related works.
    6) Conduct pre-marriage counseling to engaged couples about marriage.
    7) Assist SWO III in providing skills development to family heads and other needy adults.
    8) Assist SWO III in providing enhancement to disabled persons and elderly.
3.  **Section 3.** The corresponding appropriations and expenditures for Social Welfare Aide shall be included in the annual budget for the year [[2002]].
4.  **Section 4.** This ordinance shall take effect immediately upon approval.
5.  **Section 5.** Any ordinance or part thereof which is inconsistent with the provision of this ordinance is hereby repealed.
6.  **Section 6.** Approved by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of [[Pitogo, Quezon]] this 5th day of November, [[2001]].
